title: vLLM Qwen3 8B VDCores Batch-1 Serving Capture
command: Tree-sync the standalone pto-cu checkout to the H200 host, run the isolated vLLM environment from tmp/cuda-backend/paper-baselines/envs/vllm-27fa5aa3 with PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1, serve Qwen/Qwen3-8B on CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7 with max_model_len=192 and bfloat16, then run vllm bench serve with random input length 128, output length 64, num_prompts=1, max_concurrency=1, request_rate=inf, ignore_eos, and temperature=0.
observation: The vLLM OpenAI server reached readiness on H200 and bench serve completed one Qwen3-8B request with zero failures, mean TTFT 64.89939196035266 ms, mean ITL 5.8076567134805135 ms, output throughput 148.25853760123334 tokens/s, and request throughput 2.316539650019271 req/s.
blocker: This is a successful H200 batch-1 serving capture but not the full paper sweep: batch 2/4/8/16, repeated samples, MPK serving policy, and cross-method Qwen3-8B comparisons are still pending.
